scenarios.description: Re-running cyt-mcp user migration must strip leftover backend MCP servers from ~/.cursor/mcp.json even when cyt-mcp-usr is already up to date.

Re-running cyt-mcp workspace migration must move backends from .cursor/mcp.json to .agents/cyt/config/mcp/cursor.json and leave only cyt-mcp-ws in .cursor/mcp.json even when cyt-mcp-ws is already up to date.
